typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		TRADE_ID as decimal(38,0),
		KEYWORD_NAME as string,
		KEYWORD_VALUE as string,
		TRADE_DATE_TIME as timestamp
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource derive({Copy of TRADE_ID} = TRADE_ID,
		{Copy of KEYWORD_NAME} = KEYWORD_NAME,
		{Copy of TRADE_DATE_TIME} = TRADE_DATE_TIME,
		{Copy of KEYWORD_VALUE} = KEYWORD_VALUE) ~> DataConversion
OLEDBSource aggregate(groupBy(),
	rowcount = count(1)) ~> RowCount0
DataConversion sink(input(
		trade_id as string,
		trade_date_time as string,
		keyword_value as string,
		keyword_name as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		trade_id = TRADE_ID,
		trade_date_time = TRADE_DATE_TIME,
		keyword_value = {Copy of KEYWORD_VALUE},
		keyword_name = {Copy of KEYWORD_NAME}),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
RowCount0 sink(validateSchema: false,
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	store: 'cache',
	format: 'inline',
	output: true,
	saveOrder: 1) ~> RowCountCACHESINK
